prompt: Watch HDFCBANK and buy 3 shares when price drops 2% below today's open, with a 2% stop loss after the buy. Automatic execution.

HDFCBANK 2% below open → buy 3 + 2% SL

You can review and activate the draft in your automation panel. This is automation of your instructions, not financial advice.
